Build customer-tier infra + ERST application as one customer-funded motion. (2) Multi-country UBO economics — at least 2 EU countries (DE/NL/BE expected to follow DK on 6AMLD restrictions) demand UBO with restricted access, making customer-tier classification infrastructure economically justified to build once for several. (3) OpenOwnership BODS viability shifts — OpenOwnership announces continued DK coverage post-Sept 2025 (making OpenOwnership integration a viable lower-friction alternative to ERST direct contract) OR confirms DK is dropped from their pipeline (eliminating that fallback). (4) EU BORIS / interconnected BO register launches with usable pan-EU access — changes the economics by removing per-country contract overhead.","userDefined:ID":"DEF-20260507-B-DKUBO","Why":"Deferred at inception 2026-05-07. The API access alone is useless without customer-tier classification logic — as Tredjepartsdataleverandør, Strale may only pass DK UBO data to customers who are competent authorities, forpligtede enheder under hvidvaskloven, or press, and only via signed customer contracts. Building that gating machinery (customer attestation, contract templates mirroring tro-og-love constraints, tier-gated routing, audit trail, legal review) is 2-4 weeks of product + legal work for a single country (DK = 5.9M population). CA v1 launch is gated on bank verification, not UBO (DEC-20260420-K). Pre-revenue ICP is unvalidated — building speculatively before knowing whether buyers are AML-obliged is wrong sequencing. Framework also still being clarified: BiQ (a tredjepartsdataleverandør who participated in consultation) is publicly waiting on ERST clarification of legitim-interesse scope and the redistribution-paradox in the vejledning. Signing a contract today risks re-papering when ERST clarifies. \n\nUpdated 2026-05-07 post CC audit (read-only investigation, no commit). Original rationale assumed Strale's UBO supplement already consumed OpenOwnership BODS for DK — the audit confirmed this is false. There is no BODS / OpenOwnership integration in the codebase: beneficial-ownership-lookup.ts covers UK only via Companies House PSC direct, and returns an empty array for any non-UK jurisdiction including DK. OpenOwnership BODS was evaluated 2026-04-02 (apps/api/docs/ubo-resolve-uk-bods-evaluation.md) and explicitly deferred. The deferral decision is strengthened by this finding — there is no existing DK UBO supplement to be substituted for; both an OpenOwnership integration and an ERST direct contract are net-new builds when demand arrives, and the customer-tier infra is the dominant cost regardless of source choice. Triggers reframed accordingly — prior trigger #3 (\"BODS DK feed confirmed dead with no replacement\") retired since there is no current dependency to be killed.","Status":"deferred","Related Feature":null,"Cancelled Reason":null,"Source":"https://erhvervsstyrelsen.dk/vejledning-adgang-til-oplysninger-om-reelle-ejere","date:Date Deferred:start":"2026-05-07","date:Date Deferred:end":null,"date:Date Deferred:is_datetime":0,"What":"Apply for DK UBO API access via Erhvervsstyrelsen contract (separate process under Sept 2025 6AMLD framework)"}],"has_more":false,"data_source_ids":["95d1b8b0-52d0-4a6a-9233-1773057f6a81"]}
